description: Search thousands of real App Store listings (the top 100 free and top-grossing apps in every Apple category, refreshed daily). Filter by text, Apple genre slug, listing look (tag), today's chart rank, or apps that have preview videos. Returns slugs for get_directory_app, get_app_videos, get_app_history and create_restyle. No API key required.

category.description: Genre slug from list_directory_categories, such as finance or food-drink.

chart.description: With category: order by today's top free or top grossing chart for that category.

has_video.description: Only apps whose listing has an App Store preview video.

offset.description: For paging; count in the response is the total match count.

platform.description: ios (App Store) or android (Google Play). Default: both.

query.description: App name, developer, slug or Apple ID. Example: "duolingo".

tag.description: Listing-look slug from list_directory_tags, such as headline, device-frame or dark.

name: list_directory_apps
title: Search the screenshot library
